comment: The alignment window says the same in both clients (the gui is the reference). `emptyStates`: what the window shows instead of charts, as catalogue keys in order, for each state: hasSequence (a sequence is open), fetched (the alignment data has been asked for and answered; the gui reads it from the view model, so it is always true there), hasData (some frame has a star or earth alignment reading), processing (a run is in progress). `chartLabels`: the keys both charts name their marks and axes with (the gui as `.value(...)` names, the desktop as the chart's accessibility text and its drawn axis titles). `help`: the line over the charts about zoom, pan and click, shown in both because both charts can do all three (Ctrl+scroll, or ⌘+scroll on a Mac, zooms).
